Text.description: Describes a Property which contains plain text. This is intended exclusively for human readable strings, not for identifiers, measurement values, etc.

Timestamp.description: Describes a Property which contains the date and time with an optional timezone.

AttestationOfConformanceEntity.description: Entity to group all attestation of conformance properties.

attestationType.description: The specific type of the attestation, which defines its nature and the level of trust or authority it conveys.

standardName.description: The specific cross-sectoral standards or product or sector rules (PCRs) on which the attestation of conformance is based.

attestationStandard.description: Reference standard or rulebook which serves as the basis for the attestation of conformance.

attestationOfConformanceId.description: A unique identifier assigned to the attestation document for tracking, referencing, and verification purposes.

attestationOfConformanceLink.description: A URL or web link directing to the official digital document or registry entry to verify the authenticity and status of the attestation.

providerName.description: The official legal name of the organization or body that issued the attestation.

providerId.description: A unique identifier for the entity issuing the declaration, such as a Business Partner Number (BPN) or other official registration number, issued by the appointing organization or accreditation institute.

completedAt.description: Time stamp for when the attestation of conformity was issued

AttestationOfConformanceCollection.description: Collection of Attestation of Conformance properties for a given Asset.

attestationOfConformance.description:
Connects Asset with AttestationOfConformance to link it with AttestationOfConformanceCollection, establishing the semantic relationship and context between both entities.
Property to collect all attestation of conformance properties.
